verdict.rationale: Docs confirm provider-agnostic design supporting OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions APIs plus 100+ other LLMs, and configuration options like OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL for setting models without per-agent rewrites, indicating model/provider swapping is a first-class design goal. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of switching to a non-OpenAI provider in production and deeper docs on the LiteLLM/other-provider integration mechanics.
